# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER — SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at **[COMPANY NAME]**. We were impressed with your technical expertise, engineering leadership, and collaborative approach, and we believe you will be a valuable addition to our team.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [VP of Engineering / Engineering Manager Name]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote / Hybrid]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

## Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining our core software products. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Architecting and implementing scalable, high-quality software solutions across our [primary tech stack: e.g., backend services, web applications, mobile platforms]
- Leading technical design reviews and providing mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers
- Collaborating with product management, design, and cross-functional teams to define and deliver roadmap features
- Writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and championing engineering best practices (code reviews, CI/CD, automated testing)
- Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, reliability issues, and technical debt
- Participating in on-call rotation and incident response as needed
- Contributing to technical documentation and knowledge sharing

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly/monthly], subject to applicable withholdings and in accordance with our standard payroll practices.

**Performance Bonus:** Eligible for an annual discretionary bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonus payments are at the Company's sole discretion and require active employment on the payment date.

**Equity:** [X] shares of [common stock / stock options], vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, subject to the terms of a separate Stock Option Agreement and the Company's equity incentive plan. [Not applicable]

**Sign-On Bonus:** [$AMOUNT] sign-on bonus, [paid within 30 days of start date / paid in installments], subject to repayment provisions if employment ends within [12] months of start date. [Not applicable]

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, including:

- Health, dental, and vision insurance effective [date]
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off per year
- [X] paid holidays
- Paid parental leave per Company policy
- Professional development budget of $[X] per year
- [Remote work stipend / home office equipment allowance, if applicable]
- [Other benefits, e.g., gym membership, commuter benefits]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:

- Successful completion of a background check
- Verification of your right to work in [Country]
- Execution of required employment documents, including:
  - Confidentiality Agreement
  - Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement
  - [Non-Compete Agreement, if applicable]

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period and does not create any right to continued employment.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return by [DEADLINE DATE]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our engineering team. If you have any questions, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

**Notes on customization:** The bracketed `[placeholders]` throughout need to be filled in with your company's specifics (salary, equity grant, start date, tech stack, benefits, jurisdiction, and the acceptance deadline). I tailored the standard template for a senior engineering role by including engineering-specific responsibilities (design reviews, mentorship, on-call, CI/CD practices) and a sign-on bonus/professional development section commonly used for senior technical hires. For an even more detailed arrangement — e.g., a formal employment agreement with non-compete and IP assignment clauses, or an employee handbook section — I can draft those next.

**Disclaimer:** This document is a template for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Consult with qualified legal counsel before use, as employment laws vary by jurisdiction.
